description.p: marksight renders Markdown documents using native GTK widgets, so it follows your desktop theme automatically — light or dark, Mint-Y or Adwaita — with no configuration. It supports the full CommonMark specification plus GitHub-flavored tables, task lists, footnotes, strikethrough and alerts.

Documents reload live while you save, a collapsible table of contents navigates long files, and find-in-document highlights every match with your selection color. There is no JavaScript, no HTML rendering, and no network access — untrusted files never reach an interpreter.

ul.li: User interface translated into 100 locales besides English
Screen reader support: announced match counts, image alt text, correct heading levels
GitHub-style heading anchors and safe internal links
Documents stream into the view instead of building before the first paint
Image loading confined to the document's directory; external links open only for allowlisted schemes
Second launches open their file instantly, in a new window

description.p: See CHANGELOG.md for the full list of user-facing changes.

ul.li: CommonMark + GFM rendering to native GTK widgets
Live reload on save, table of contents sidebar, find in document
